shader_include_edit.scope: shader-only fixture using the full committed 3D shader manifest

compiler_cache.scope: one unchanged game source, object compilation only; no linking

notes: C++ edit samples append a different comment, forcing real compilation with the compiler cache disabled; original source restored afterwards.
Medians use three runs; background workloads and filesystem caches were not controlled.
Shader timings are one run per configuration and exclude C++ embedding/linking.
PCH creation, dependency fetching and initial builds are excluded from edit timings.
A like-for-like full clean-build comparison was not performed.
GCC 3D compile checks cover gpu_gi3d.cpp, gpu_renderer3d.cpp, lua_scene3d.cpp and their relevant PCHs; not a complete 3D runtime test.
